Usage: memoriahub android keystore import [options] <file>

Use an existing keystore (passwords from
ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD, else a prompt)

Arguments:
  file             The .jks / .keystore / .p12 file

Options:
  --alias <alias>  Key alias (default: "memoriahub")
  -h, --help       display help for command
